description.value: Sam's Chaat House is a Richmond restaurant specializing in Indian street food — particularly chaat, the tangy, layered snack dishes popular across the Indian subcontinent. The menu features classics like Golgappa, Papdi Chaat, Raj Kachori, and Pav Bhaji, all appearing to be entirely vegetarian. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, and provides full catering services for events.

The entire visible menu consists of vegetarian items (chaat, paneer, pakora, puri dishes) with no meat listed, supporting a vegetarian-true claim.
